desc: The Bosch 500 Series 30-inch Built-In Microwave Oven is constructed to take the difficulty out of delicious meal preparation. The large 1.6.-cu. ft. interior gives you more flexibility in what types of dishes you can cook, while the 950 watts of power and convenient automatic sensor programs ensure quick, perfect results every time.
hl: Appliances are completely flush with your cabinetry, so they blend in beautifully and never protrude.
This large cooking interior gives you the flexibility to cook various dishes.
Convenient automatic sensor programs simplify cooking for perfect results.
Provides improved distribution of microwave energy for more even cooking.
Touch controls with printed display panel make selecting modes easy.
spec: ADA Compliant (When Installed to ADA requirements)
1 x grid high, 1 x grid flat
